This value is very close to Option B (**0.89829**). Given the systematic spacing of the options (0.89229, 0.89329, 0.89429, 0.89829), and the fact that 0.89829 aligns with the result for a 30% mixing ratio of a salt-representative solution, it is the most plausible answer.

Simulation results for different mixing ratios showed that lower ratios (e.g., 5-10% seawater) matched the other options (0.892–0.894), confirming that the choice of 0.89829 corresponds specifically to the 0.3 ratio.
